All source units outside the LOD/bore targets keep their original triangles and colors, except whole components that pass strict native opaque-material containment.
Red and green light-bearing small units are excluded from hidden-unit candidates. No visibility sampling authorizes deletion.
Only complete small circular bores with two planar inner-wire ends are plugged. Countersinks, curved ends, partial turns and unresolved intersections are skipped.
Native union with finite plugs bounds geometric additions by construction. Full complex-source difference is not claimed for this constructive pass.

Small hardware LOD is limited to <=20 mm source units made entirely of listed analytic surfaces, excluding red/green light-bearing units. The size/type filter is a quality policy, not a functional identity.
